loader.welcome: Welcome to the Arab Innovation and Investment Forum

conferences.title: Entrepreneurship and Digital Transformation
conferences.description: Recognizing the crucial role of entrepreneurship and innovation in economic development and job creation, this conference focused on how digital transformation can drive progress in alignment with Egypt’s Vision 2030.
objectives: Gather young entrepreneurs to shape their future.
Utilize youth skills and talents to enhance societal roles.
Enhance youth capabilities in innovation and digital transformation.
highlights: Showcased various tech projects with the participation of the Egyptian SME Authority and the Federation of Egyptian Industries.
Attended by Arab delegations, including the Ministry of Youth & Sports, Jordanian and Egyptian Parliaments, ambassadors, and diplomatic representatives.
outcomes: 25 emerging tech startups received funding and support.
Launched a training initiative for 500 youth in entrepreneurship.
Kickstarted the ‘Capable Youth’ initiative in Jordan.
A startup won the ‘Best Entrepreneurial Project’ award from Orange and Aspire.

conferences.title: Promising Investment and Innovation Opportunities
conferences.description: In light of rapid economic changes and global transformations, the role of entrepreneurship is highlighted as a key pillar for sustainable development and driving innovation. The conference serves as a platform for Arab entrepreneurs and investors to discuss the challenges and opportunities in the region, focusing on investment in innovative ideas and startups.
objectives: Attract investments to the region by showcasing investment opportunities.
Encourage export and market expansion for businesses.
Increase trade exchange between Arab countries and other markets.
Create new job opportunities through supporting investment projects.
Engage Arab and African investors to foster collaborations.
Support entrepreneurship and innovation in the public and private sectors.
highlights: Organized with the patronage of the Ministry of Youth & Sports, and attended by various governmental bodies, media outlets, and entrepreneurship organizations.
Involved a committee led by expert Mr. Magdy Wahba to select the most promising projects for display at the conference.
Public announcements and press conferences were conducted, with a press conference held by the Minister of Youth & Sports, Dr. Ashraf Sobhi.
outcomes: Awarded the Best Emerging Startup award.
Presented the Best Arab Entrepreneur award.
Recognized the Best Technological Project award.
Facilitated connections for a project with the Ministry of Youth & Sports incubator.
Facilitated connections for a project with the Egyptian Workers' Union.
Approved the Arab expansion of a key startup in February 2025.
Launched an entrepreneurship training program with the upcoming Innovest Arab Forum 3rd edition.

about.desc: The Arab Innovation and Investment Forum is a leading platform that brings together entrepreneurs, investors, and experts from the Arab world to enhance the environment for innovation and sustainable investment. The forum aims to empower youth and innovators to transform their ideas into successful projects through networking, knowledge exchange, and showcasing investment opportunities. It focuses on exploring the latest trends in entrepreneurship, technology, and finance while providing a supportive environment for partnerships and the development of strategic relationships between investors and startup founders.
